name: Hindmark Bank
description: A mid-sized private bank with about 900 branches, mostly in western and central India. It lends to households and small businesses and takes deposits.

name: Coastline Bank
description: A regional private bank based in Kerala and coastal Karnataka. Most of its loans are home, gold and small-business loans.

name: Meridian Motors
description: Makes passenger cars and small commercial vans. Sells mainly in India and exports to a few markets in Africa and South Asia.

name: Northstar Infotech
description: An IT services company that builds and runs software for banks and retailers. Most of its revenue comes from clients in the US and Europe.

name: Skyreach Telecom
description: A mobile and broadband operator in north and east India. It has borrowed heavily to pay for spectrum and network expansion.

name: Kirti Engineering
description: Makes electrical and mechanical equipment for metro rail, power and water projects. Revenue depends on winning large government and private orders.

name: Sahyog Finance
description: A non-bank lender that gives two-wheeler and small-business loans in smaller towns. It borrows from banks and the bond market to fund its loans.

name: Brightpath Learning
description: Sells online coaching for school and entrance exams through an app. It has made losses in each of the last three years.

name: Dhanvi Consumer
description: Makes packaged foods, tea and personal-care products sold through local shops across India. Its brands are strongest in smaller towns.

name: Rangoli Paints
description: Makes decorative paints for homes and some industrial coatings. It sells through about 30,000 dealers.

name: Prakriti Energy
description: Refines crude oil and sells fuel through its own petrol pumps in western India. Its profits move with the gap between crude and fuel prices.

name: Kestrel Renewables
description: A small company that installs rooftop solar panels for homes and shops. Its yearly revenue is small compared with its stock-market value.

name: Hindmark Life Insurance
description: A life insurer selling term, savings and pension plans. Many of its policies are sold in the branches of Hindmark Bank, which is a different company.

name: Aushadh Pharma
description: Makes generic medicines for India and for export to regulated markets. Its largest products treat diabetes and heart conditions.
